resources.string:
Tested and developed on: FiiO JM21, firmware 1.1.3.
Other FiiO devices: Untested and unverified. Might work.
Other devices play normal PCM; DSD output is not expected to work.
Planned: DSD output to USB DACs (native DSD and DoP).
Audio player with Audigma PCM to DSD upsampling integrated.\nA fork of Auxio, a simple, rational music player for Android.
